name: quantritute
description: Quản trị tử tế – website + trang quản trị riêng (Cloudflare Pages + D1)

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:site && npm run deploy:admin && npm run deploy:watch
scripts.deploy:site: cd site && wrangler pages deploy --project-name quantritute --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:admin: cd admin && wrangler pages deploy --project-name quantritute-admin --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.dev:site: cd site && wrangler pages dev --port 8788 --persist-to ../.state --d1 DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
scripts.dev:admin: cd admin && wrangler pages dev --port 8789 --inspector-port 9330 --persist-to ../.state --d1 DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --binding ADMIN_TOKEN=matkhauthu123
